users: researchers collecting and analyzing InfraRed Imaging Station tube-fin experiments
supported_tasks: fit a declared one-dimensional fin model
not_intended_for: a calibrated thermal-property measurement without instrument, geometry, emissivity, and model-form validation; or a hardware-independent data-collection guarantee

required_inputs: calibrated sensor context when interpreting quantitative results

limitations: Serial collection is hardware- and platform-dependent.
Inverse effective-conductivity estimates depend on image processing, geometry, boundary assumptions, and calibration.
